targets: All handwritten pure provider and canonical contract decisions in the maintained source inventory; the canonical consumer client and example reader require separate instrumentation.
instrumentationProof: Reconcile actual instrumented source files and their SHA-256 values with the configured source inventory. A score from one project does not establish coverage of separately referenced projects or the consumer/example scope.
reviewEvidencePolicy: Preserve every raw status and score. Only exact, individually substantiated equivalence or compiler non-viability may be reconciled. A valid CompileError or default-filtered block can be resolved as IndependentlyKilled only by its exact replacement, a complete passing configured baseline, and a complete failing configured mutant run with no missing or skipped cases. Raw Timeout, NoCoverage, RuntimeError, and Pending cannot be waived.
campaignEvidence: Exact source inventory before and after execution
Tool and SDK identities and resolved dependency hashes
Raw mutation reports and process exit codes
Individual evidence for any reviewed equivalence or compiler non-viability
lastRun: Run results are written separately; this policy is not evidence that a campaign passed.
